prompts.title: Swim
prompts.label: Swim
prompts.desktop: WASD or the arrow keys swim. Head right.
prompts.touch: Drag anywhere on the left of the screen to swim. Head right.

prompts.title: Dash
prompts.label: Dash
prompts.desktop: Space or Shift dashes. Mid-dash nothing can hurt you: get close, then dash through the urchins.
prompts.touch: Tap Dash for a burst of speed. Mid-dash nothing can hurt you: get close, then dash through the urchins.

prompts.title: Ink Jet
prompts.label: Ink
prompts.desktop: Left click squirts ink at the cursor (J or K: straight ahead). It refills slowly, watch the jet on your bar. Shoot the fish bones to open the coral.
prompts.touch: Tap Jet to squirt ink at what is near. It refills slowly, watch the jet on your bar. Shoot the fish bones to open the coral.

prompts.title: Grab and throw
prompts.label: Grab
prompts.desktop: F or middle click grabs a pot. Press again to throw it at the cursor, hold to set it down. Throw one at the fish bones. A carried pot takes a hit for you.
prompts.touch: Stop next to a pot and tap Grab. Tap Throw to fling it the way you swim. Throw one at the fish bones. A carried pot takes a hit for you.

prompts.title: Bomb the floor
prompts.label: Bombs
prompts.desktop: Your bomb is picked on the bar. Over the cracked floor press C (or right click on yourself) to drop it, then swim clear. B or X drops one any time. Outside the tutorial a blast kills you.
prompts.touch: Your bomb is picked on the bar. Over the cracked floor tap Bomb to drop it, then swim clear. Outside the tutorial a blast kills you.

prompts.title: Sticky mine
prompts.label: Sticky
prompts.desktop: Point at the cracked wall and right click: the bomb flies there and sticks to the rock. Then back off.
prompts.touch: Hold the stick toward the cracked wall and tap Bomb: the bomb flies there and sticks to the rock. Then back off.

prompts.title: Spells
prompts.label: Spells
prompts.desktop: Q, E or the wheel pick a slot on your bar. Pick Ink Cloud and right click or press C: the piranha loses you in the ink. Spells drink fish juice; the jar refills only at the rest grotto, unless you carry the Siphon Shell.
prompts.touch: Tap Spell to puff an Ink Cloud: the piranha loses you in the ink. Spells drink fish juice; the jar refills only at the rest grotto, unless you carry the Siphon Shell.

prompts.title: Shop
prompts.label: Shop
prompts.desktop: Swim up to a ware and press F to buy it. Today it is free. In a real shop, carrying off or shooting a ware makes the keeper come for you.
prompts.touch: Stop next to a ware and tap Grab to buy it. Today it is free. In a real shop, carrying off or shooting a ware makes the keeper come for you.

prompts.title: Boulders
prompts.label: Boulder
prompts.desktop: A boulder drops when you swim under it. Blasts shake them loose too: one thing sets off the next.
prompts.touch: A boulder drops when you swim under it. Blasts shake them loose too: one thing sets off the next.

prompts.title: Spikes
prompts.label: Spikes
prompts.desktop: Spikes kill at once, hearts or not. Look before you sink.
prompts.touch: Spikes kill at once, hearts or not. Look before you sink.

prompts.title: Clams and jets
prompts.label: Clam
prompts.desktop: Giant clams snap on what swims in; tentacles grab and hold (dash to wriggle free). Jets push you up.
prompts.touch: Giant clams snap on what swims in; tentacles grab and hold (dash to wriggle free). Jets push you up.

prompts.title: Dive
prompts.label: Dive
prompts.desktop: Swim to the whirlpool and press F to dive. Down there the Beholder comes for slow divers after about 2:30; be quick for a Swift Current shell. Tab opens your journal.
prompts.touch: Swim to the whirlpool and tap Grab to dive. Down there the Beholder comes for slow divers after about 2:30; be quick for a Swift Current shell. Your journal is in the pause menu.
